paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the Short-Dependence Attention Weight for different methods, comparing their reliance on proximal text. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as Methods, and lists five distinct methods in the following order: Standard, ICLM, KNN, Quest, and NExtLong. The vertical axis is labeled "Attention Weight" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.80 to 0.90, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. Each method is represented by a light blue bar, with the height corresponding to its attention weight value. The bars have the following approximate heights: Standard at 0.865, ICLM at 0.855, KNN at 0.86, Quest at 0.863, and NExtLong at 0.823. The chart is not sorted by bar height, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The bars are individual and not grouped or stacked.
